extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: lowrider (lowered 1960s hardtop), approx. 5.6 x 2.0 x 1.3 m (L x W x H), wire wheels 0.66 m with whitewall tires
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); continental spare wheel behind the trunk is part of the body; hollow pillarless cabin with bench seats and steering wheel; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
